title: Compact Upgrade Health Beacon & Connectivity Heatmap for Private Console
creator: Maya Alvarez
description:
Problem: Operators and platform engineers need a concise surface in the Private Console to quickly assess cluster upgrade health and VPC connectivity risk without drilling into multiple pages. Existing cluster pages are dense; during rollouts customers ask for a single line-of-sight scoreboard for upgrade progress, outstanding blockers, and a spatialized connectivity signal for affected subnets and peers.

This ticket proposes a compact "Upgrade Health Beacon" combined with a horizontal micro-heatmap that summarizes connectivity and egress risk per cluster/tenant row. The pattern is intentionally lightweight for tenancy lists but links into a detailed upgrade timeline and packet-path simulator for deeper investigation.

Goals:
- Reduce cognitive load for on-call users during upgrade windows.
- Surface actionable blockers (eg. failed node drains, pending KMS rotations, peering flaps).
- Make it easy to jump to targeted remediation flows (rollback, canary rollback, retry drain).

Scope: low-fidelity > interactive prototype > handoff assets > design review with Eng/PM > minor a11y pass.
acceptance_criteria: Compact beacon appears in the cluster list row and shows a single health state (Healthy / Warning / Degraded / Blocked)
Heatmap displays 4 columns: Internal Connectivity, Egress Paths, Route Tables, Peering Status with color-coded cells and tooltip detail
Beacon click opens the upgrade mini-panel overlay showing progress bar, top 3 blockers, and quick actions (Retry, Pause Rollout, Escalate)
Prototype tested with 6 operator users; 80% can identify root cause column and launch remediation within 30s
All interactive elements meet WCAG contrast and keyboard focus guidelines
decisions: Keep beacon single-state to prevent alert confusion; use tooltip for history and staged granularity
Heatmap limited to 4, lightweight columns to preserve narrow list layout on small viewports
Quick actions exposed for common remediations only; advanced actions live in the full upgrade timeline page
Represent perf telemetry with sparklines only in detailed panel, not in the compact row
tradeoffs_and_risks: Risk: condensation of information may hide nuanced multi-cluster failures — mitigated via one-click overlay linking to full timeline
Tradeoff: color-only cells are compact but not accessible; added icon+text tooltip and high-contrast palette to address a11y
Performance: rendering heatmaps for large tenancies could be expensive; will request backend aggregated endpoint (ENG-33421)
user_testing_notes: Session 1 (3 SREs): users liked the single row summary but requested explicit timestamps for last successful drain
Session 2 (3 Platform Eng): asked for a trigger to open the packet-path simulator when egress path shows failures
Accessibility pass: keyboard nav present; screen reader labels need clearer phrasing (recommended change in assets)
feedback: PM (Ravi Patel): prioritize showing KMS/key rotation as a first-class blocker for enterprise users
Eng (Lena Zhou): prefer server-side aggregation for heatmap cells to avoid client rendering spikes; flagged ENG-33421
Security (Aisha Grant): flagged audit logging for quick actions — add audit entry on Pause/Rollback buttons
next_steps: Incorporate PM feedback to surface KMS status icon in beacon tooltip
Update Figma with revised screen-reader labels and high-contrast palettes (due 2026-03-15)
Handoff to ENG for backend aggregation endpoint and API contract (ENG-33421)
Schedule design review with security to confirm audit logging requirement (meeting 2026-03-16)
Prepare A/B experiment plan for rollout to 20% of tenants for 2 weeks
implementation_notes: Frontend: render static SVG micro-heatmap + aria-labels; avoid heavy JS loops over nodes
Backend: new /clusters/{id}/health-compact aggregation endpoint returning 4-state buckets per column
Telemetry: emit metric cluster.upgrade_beacon_clicks and event for quick-action triggers
Fallback: if aggregation endpoint unavailable, show greyed unknown state and link to cluster page
notes_for_eng: Please advise on expected payload size for 5k clusters; if > 200KB we'll need pagination
Add feature flag console.compactUpgradeBeacon to gate rollout
Ensure action endpoints are idempotent and emit audit log events
